Container.Name: RecompManager
Container.Overview: Self-hosted library for game recompilations and decompilation ports. Tracks GitHub releases, stores builds for every platform, keeps your own game dumps in a private vault, and serves install plans to clients over a token-protected REST API.[br][br] First start: open the web UI and log in with the admin token the server writes to admin-token.txt in the Config folder. Create your own tokens in Settings, then delete that file.[br][br] [b]Docker socket (optional):[/b] mounting /var/run/docker.sock lets the server run game builds in sibling containers. Access to the Docker socket is effectively root on this Unraid host. Leave it empty unless you want server-side builds. When you do mount it, HOST_DATA_PATH must equal the host path you mapped to /data.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Release files, game inputs and build outputs. Can grow very large (tens of GB per game).

Config.Name: ROM library
Config.Description: Optional. Your ROM/dump share. Scanned (read-only, recursively) to find each game's inputs: ROMs by checksum (also inside zips), PS4 and Switch dump folders by title ID. Nothing in it is changed.

Config.Name: Import folder
Config.Description: Optional. A share you drop large game dumps into for importing. Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: HOST_DATA_PATH
Config.Description: Must be the same host path as Library (/data). Build containers need it for their mounts.

Config.Name: Docker socket (root-equivalent)
Config.Description: Optional. Set to /var/run/docker.sock to enable server-side builds. Gives this container root-level control of the host.
